metadata.aggregation: Province and prefecture counts sum the counties with both a 2010 and a 2020 count, not official full-region totals. Units merged by the source to keep boundaries comparable appear as one county. A few changes reflect boundary transfers the source could not adjust (Harbin's Pingfang and Xiangfang districts).
